dataset_meta.name: Standardized Daily ETF Holdings
dataset_meta.subcategory: Employee Data (platform mis-label; real content = cross-sectional ETF holdings-change statistics)
dataset_meta.probe_method: WorldQuant BRAIN REST /data-fields full pull (403 MATRIX) + 36 real REGULAR simulation probes (USA/TOP1000/D1, decay=0, neutralization=NONE, truncation=0, nan_handling=OFF, 2014-01-01..2023-12-31, FULL), 2026-11-08

verified_findings.F1_sign_constraint: Sign-partitioned statistics carry a hard sign constraint: positive_* skewness >= 0 (probe E56M1axJ long=855/short=7); negative_* skewness <= 0 (probe rKRwYz8J long=9/short=840); count/average/sum/variance are non-negative (long-only books, 830-906 long / 0 short). Pooled change_skewness (489/398), percent_change_average (601/297) and change_log_weighted_skewness (488/400) are genuinely two-sided.
verified_findings.F2_sparsity: Zero-density probes: equal(change_count,0) long=131; equal(negative_change_count,0) long=159; equal(positive_change_count,0) long=151 out of ~900 names -> 15-18% zero mass on count/level fields (is_sparse=true). equal(change_skewness,0) long=1 -> skewness fields are dense, not sparse.
verified_findings.F3_update_frequency: Daily continuous refresh. ts_std_dev(change_skewness,66) turnover=0.0141 versus ts_std_dev(change_skewness,5) turnover=0.3127 -> 22x turnover decay from the 5d to the 66d window. A step-wise (quarterly) series would show near-zero turnover at 66d. The _5d/_20d/_60d suffixes are ROLLING CHANGE WINDOWS over daily ETF holdings, NOT update frequencies; every field refreshes every trading day.
verified_findings.F4_not_a_storage_stock: Level/statistic fields re-price every session: change_variance turnover=0.7681; negative_change_variance turnover=0.9081; change_log_weighted_skewness turnover=0.7715. These are quasi-daily quantities, structurally unusable as low-turnover storage/structure legs; the platform's CONCENTRATED_WEIGHT=1.0 on them confirms an extreme-value profile.
verified_findings.F5_count_asymmetry: Breadth counts split into a sticky edge and a fast edge: change_count turnover=0.0954 (sticky) versus negative_change_count turnover=0.3089 (fast churn). The negative-side counting edge is the noisy, fast-moving one; the positive side is the slow accumulation.
verified_findings.F6_sign_convention: count and variance are MAGNITUDES (>= 0) even inside a negative bucket (change_count 902L/0S; negative_change_count 874L/0S; negative_change_variance 830L/0S). A sign-partitioned mean/average/cubed_sum KEEPS ITS SIGN (negative_change_average 0L/874S; negative_percent_change_average_20d 0L/874S; negative_percent_change_cubed_sum 0L/874S; positive_percent_change_cubed_sum 868L/0S). Pooled percent-scope mean/cubed_sum/skewness are genuinely two-sided (percent_change_mean 669L/222S; percent_change_cubed_sum 523L/375S; percent_change_average 601L/297S). Skewness of a sign-partitioned bucket is sign-constrained by construction (positive_change_skewness 855L/7S; negative_change_skewness 9L/840S).
